  "CRITERIA_MATCH_EXPLANATION": "This paper focuses on regional curriculum harmonization initiatives in Africa, specifically addressing the harmonization of higher education programs across countries. For example, it mentions the harmonization efforts in the East African Community (EAC) and the African Union's efforts to create a common higher education space.",
  "Title": "The Quest for Harmonization of Higher Education in Africa: Regional Initiatives and Implementation Challenges",

    "Main_Findings": [
      "Harmonization of higher education in Africa is crucial for promoting regional integration and economic development.",
      "Significant progress has been made in developing regional frameworks and initiatives.",
      "Implementation challenges remain, including lack of political will, inadequate funding, and varying quality standards."
